name: iter_regime_forgetting
description: Isolates catastrophic forgetting across the loop. Runs all six tracks (guided/random x accumulative/new-only/scaled-accum) while sweeping the rehearsal mix from pure uniform to pure guided at a NARROW kernel (sel_sigma 0.1), the setting under which the companion paper traced the parity -> advantage -> collapse arc in a single round. Repeating it round after round tests whether the crossover near alpha ~ 0.4 is a property of the method or, as the paper suspected, of its new-points-only protocol: the accumulative tracks should soften or remove the collapse while new-only reproduces it. err_out (error OUTSIDE the induced gap) and forget_guided / forget_random are the metrics to read. One detector, 10 seeds.
